# One native home for every local model on your Mac

Every text, image, and speech model already on your Mac — pulled through Ollama, cached by Hugging Face, or dropped in by hand — discovered and run in one native app built for Apple Silicon. Local-first, private, and free.

Private by design

## Nothing leaves your Mac.

The only server here is the one on your desk.

Local & offline

Every model runs on your machine. Turn the Wi-Fi off — it still works.

Private

Your prompts, outputs, and models never leave your hardware. No telemetry, no accounts.

Native & fast

A real Swift app for Apple Silicon on Apple's MLX foundation — no browser wrapper.

Free & open

MIT. Free to use, read, and fork. No lock-in, no black box.

Discovery → Runtime

## Found where they live. Run however they run best.

Hedos finds every model already on your Mac — no matter who installed it — and serves each one on whatever engine runs it best. Discovered, then run.

$ hedos ls

Every model wears its tier openly — runs natively, via a managed runtime, or needs a recipe. The shelf tells you the truth before you click.

Install

## Two ways in. Nothing more.

Download the app, or install it with Homebrew. Either way you get the native app and the hedos command-line tool — the app installs the command for you.

### DMG

A signed build for Apple Silicon. Drag it into Applications and open — it has already scanned your Mac.

### Homebrew

Installs the app and links the hedos command in one step.
